title: CityNexus - Smart City Traveler System   |   System Architecture
subtitle: How the product actually runs. A traveler request enters the React shell, is served by one FastAPI monolith, and may be reasoned about by an AI agent that owns no domain truth: every agent mutation passes an allowlist, an audit write and an authorization decision before a deterministic solver touches journey state.
revline: Rev A · generated 2026-10-22 · source tree D:\moodle\CityNexus @ review/boli-party-occupancy-scope-r1

bands.label: 3   BACKEND HTTP SURFACE   one FastAPI monolith, 175 endpoints under /api/v1   (backend/app/main.py, 14,569 lines)
4a   AI AGENT & HERMES PLANE   the agent owns no domain truth   (backend/app/agent)
4b   DOMAIN SERVICES   deterministic solver, business facts, journey state machine
5a   PROVIDERS & INTEGRATIONS   9 clients; the deterministic mocks are the shipped default
5b   PERSISTENCE, AUDIT & OPERATIONAL STATE   SQLAlchemy + SQLite (WAL), 60 tables

Traveler
phone, tablet landscape, desktop browser

Administrator
platform and provider console

CopilotDock + AgentComposer
the natural-language input box

AgentRunRail + feed
shows the agent working state

V8Experience shell
offline snapshot, execution clock, wallet

Plan comparison + Trip Studio
accept or reject what the agent proposes

JourneyMap
MapLibre 5.24, OpenFreeMap style, provenance badges

15 routed panels
hub, live, map, studio, stay, discover, agent, twin, footprints, access

Agent surface
/copilot/messages, /agent/commands, /agent/tools/{name}, /approvals/{id}/approve, /agent-feed; the MCP V1 and V2 surfaces reach the same gateway

Shared transport
journeys, plans, places, replans, check-ins, collections, share, bookings - 175 endpoints

Data & ops surface
/experience, /twin, /route-evidence, SSE /operations/stream, OpenAPI, server-owned agent identity

Entry: intent + context
8 intents over a server-built context; semantic envelope decides what the model may conclude

Mission, plan, tool loop
compile_mission, build_mission_plan, run(max_steps=12); DeepSeekJourneyAgent

Tool gateway
allowlist of 11 tools, audit write, idempotency, then ALLOW_AUTO / REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION / DENY

Journeys, plans, replans
lifecycle, deterministic seeded solver, proposal-only replanning, accept / reject

Twin, capability, preference
three preference scopes; declared-not-invented budget and party size

Places, city services, commerce, guardian
real-city discovery, catalog hydration, bookings and commitments, autopilot

DeepSeek Responses API
chat, vision, web search; ai_enabled defaults to false

Shipped default provider set
mock city / mobility / booking / payment; real-city mode=replay

Photon, Nominatim, Overpass
geocode, POI, weather; Valhalla live URL not set

SQLite citynexus.db
WAL, foreign keys ON, write deadline and busy timeout

Journey truth
journeys, plan_versions, activities, commitments, events, journey_twins, replan_proposals

Agent state and audit
journey_missions, agent_runs, agent_run_steps, action_approvals, audit_logs, idempotency_keys
